You+Me - Against the World is an upcoming romance drama adapted from the bestselling novel Toi+Moi by Emma Green. The story follows 18-year-old Alma Lancaster, a young woman from a wealthy family who believes she is pursuing a respectable degree in law. In reality, Alma is secretly following her true passion for filmmaking. Her life takes an intense turn on campus when she meets Vadim Arcadi, a 20-year-old rebellious, magnetic loner with a troubled past.

When forced to pair up and collaborate on a student film project, initial sparks and personality clashes quickly deepen into an overwhelming, forbidden passion. However, their growing bond is put to the ultimate test when a mysterious figure begins sending anonymous threats. As hidden secrets threaten to surface and ruin both of their lives, Alma and Vadim must navigate the high-stakes danger together, leaning into a true “us against the world” dynamic.

Starring Vittoria Di Savoia and Lucas Barski and directed by Manon Gaurin, the film promises a blend of dark romance, secret-keeping, and suspense. You+Me - Against the World is set to premiere globally on Amazon Prime Video on September 18, 2026.
